abrasion.definitionKo: 금속이나 돌 등을 갈고 닦아 표면을 반질반질하게 함.
abrasion.englishDescription: The act of grinding and polishing a metal, rock, etc., and smoothening the surface.

abrasion.definitionKo: 마찰이 일어난 부분이 닳아서 작아지거나 없어짐.
abrasion.englishDescription: A state in which a part of something gets smaller or worn out after being repeatedly rubbed against something else.
A wound from scratching or scraping against something.

accelerator.definitionKo: 발로 밟아 자동차의 속도를 높이는 장치.
accelerator.englishDescription: A device that a driver steps on to increase the speed of the car.
A substance used in a process as a catalyst.

affluent.englishDescription: Wanting nothing because one is well off.

affluent.definitionKo: 강의 큰 줄기로 흘러 들어가거나 큰 줄기에서 나온 작은 물줄기.
affluent.englishDescription: A stream that flows into or from a main stem river.

agwi.definitionKo: 두루마기나 여자들이 입는 한복의 아랫도리 속옷의 옆을 터 놓은 구멍.
agwi.englishDescription: side slit; side placket: The side opening of durumagi, a traditional Korean overcoat or women's lower undergarment in hanbok, the traditional Korean outfit.

agwi.definitionKo: 활의 한가운데 손으로 쥐는 부분과 금속 부분이 닿는, 안으로 조금 들어간 부분.
agwi.englishDescription: grip: The central metallic part of a bow that is curved slightly inward that the archer holds for shooting.

ampleness.englishDescription: The state of being plenty and abundant, or such a feeling.

angled.definitionKo: 모양이 둥글지 않고 각이 져 있다.
angled.englishDescription: A shape being angular, not round.

annoyance.definitionKo: 마음에 들지 않아서 화를 내거나 싫은 느낌을 겉으로 드러내는 일. 또는 그런 성미.
annoyance.englishDescription: An act of expressing one's anger or dislike towards something because one is dissatisfied, or such a disposition.

anti-japan.definitionKo: 일본 제국주의의 침략과 통치에 맞서서 싸움.
anti-japan.englishDescription: An act of fighting against the invasion and rule of Japanese imperialism.

apprehend.definitionKo: 수사 기관이 법을 어기거나 범죄를 저지른 사람을 잡아 가두다.
apprehend.englishDescription: For law enforcement authorities to catch and lock up a person who has broken the law or committed a crime.

apprehend.definitionKo: 법원에서 신문하기 위하여 피고인이나 증인, 사건에 관계된 사람 등을 강제로 끌고 가다.
apprehend.englishDescription: To forcefully take a person related to a case such as a defendant, witness,etc., to court for questioning.

articial.definitionKo: 자연적인 것이 아니라 사람의 힘으로 만들어 낸.
articial.englishDescription: Made by human power, not by nature.

autonomize.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 구속하지 않고 자기 스스로의 원칙에 따라 하도록 하다.
autonomize.englishDescription: To do something according to one's own principles without being restricted.

away.englishDescription: To that place, or in that direction.
To that place, or in that direction.
(emphasizing form) To that place, or in that direction.

awesome.englishDescription: So great as to make someone feel afraid.

bapjubal.definitionKo: 위가 약간 벌어지고 뚜껑이 있는, 놋쇠로 만든 밥그릇.
bapjubal.englishDescription: brass rice bowl: An open-top container with a cover, which is made of brass and used to serve rice.

bar.englishDescription: A long piece of metal or a rod that slides into a hole to lock the door.
A bar in which people have quick drinks standing.

bar.definitionKo: 악보에서, 마디를 구분하기 위해 세로로 그은 줄.
bar.englishDescription: In a sheet of music, a vertical line drawn to separate measures.

bar.definitionKo: 악보에서, 마디를 구분하기 위해 세로로 그은 줄 중에 특히 한 줄로 그은 가느다란 선.
bar.englishDescription: In a sheet of music, one thin line, in particular, among some vertical lines that separate measures.

bar.definitionKo: 말, 글, 노래 등을 일정하게 나눈 부분.
bar.englishDescription: Parts of a speech, writing, song, etc., that are equally divided.

bar.definitionKo: 창이나 문 등에 가로세로로 지르게 대어 놓은 가는 막대.
bar.englishDescription: Thin rod attached horizontally and vertically to a window, door, etc.

bar.definitionKo: 말, 글, 노래 등을 일정하게 나눈 부분.
bar.englishDescription: Egments of a speech, writing, song, etc. that are equally spaced.
In a musical score, the parts divided by vertical lines.

bathroom.definitionKo: 대변이나 소변을 볼 수 있는 시설이 있는 장소.
bathroom.englishDescription: A place with facilities for defecating or urinating.

bathroom.definitionKo: 목욕을 할 수 있도록 시설을 갖춘 방.
bathroom.englishDescription: A room equipped with a facility for taking a bath.

bhutan.definitionKo: 아시아의 남부, 히말라야 산기슭에 있는 나라. 국토의 대부분이 산악 지대이며, 주요 생산물로는 쌀, 밀 등이 있다. 주요 언어는 티베트어이고 수도는 팀푸이다.
bhutan.englishDescription: A country located at the foot of the Himalayas in the south of Asia; most of its land is mountainous and it is a major producer of rice, wheat, etc.; its official language is Tibetan and its capital is Thimpu.

blow.definitionKo: 어떤 물체가 바람을 따라 움직이거나 흩어지게 하다.
blow.englishDescription: For an object to move on, or be scattered, by a wind.

blow.definitionKo: 바람이 물체를 움직여 소리가 나게 하다.
blow.englishDescription: For the wind to sway an object, letting it make a sound.

blow.definitionKo: 바람이 세차게 불거나 비나 눈 등이 세차게 오다.
blow.englishDescription: For a wind to blow hard; or for rain, snow, etc., to fall hard.

blow.definitionKo: 공중이나 물 위에 떠서 미끄러지듯이 움직이다.
blow.englishDescription: To glide in the air or on the water.

blow.definitionKo: 콧속에 있는 콧물을 숨을 세게 내쉬어 밖으로 나오게 하다.
blow.englishDescription: To let out one's nasal discharge by breathing out hard.
For a wind to form and move in a certain direction.

blow.definitionKo: 입으로 숨을 내쉬어 입김을 내거나 바람을 일으키다.
blow.englishDescription: To use the mouth to blow or create wind.

blow.definitionKo: 관악기를 입에 대고 숨을 내쉬어 소리를 내다.
blow.englishDescription: To put a wind instrument to the mouth and exhale to make a sound.

blow.definitionKo: 거세게 펄펄 흩어져 날다. 또는 그렇게 날게 하다.
blow.englishDescription: To fly wildly in a scattered manner; or to make something fly in such a manner.

borigogae.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 그 전 해에 거두어들인 곡식은 다 떨어지고 보리는 아직 익지 않아 먹을 것이 모자라서 어려운 때.
borigogae.englishDescription: barley hump: (figurative) A period when food is not enough because the crops harvested in the previous year are exhausted and barley is not yet ripe.

boryo.definitionKo: 솜이나 털로 속을 두껍게 넣고 천으로 겉을 곱게 싸서 앉는 자리에 늘 깔아 두는 요.
boryo.englishDescription: traditional Korean cushion: A mattress-style cushion always spread on a sitting area, which is thickly stuffed with cotton or feathers and then covered with cloth.

bumper-to-bumper.definitionKo: 도로에 차가 많이 몰려 길이 막히고 혼잡한 상태.
bumper-to-bumper.englishDescription: A chaotic state in which too many cars are on the road slowing down traffic.

bungeobbang.definitionKo: 붕어 모양의 틀에 묽은 밀가루 반죽을 붓고 팥이나 크림을 넣어 구운 빵.
bungeobbang.englishDescription: Bread made by pouring thin flour batter into a carp-shaped mold and baking it with red beans or cream.
(figurative) A person whose face is very similar to a person.

bustling.englishDescription: Splendid and active in commercial activities.

bustling.definitionKo: 급하게 서두르거나 시끄럽게 떠들어서 어수선한 느낌이 있다.
bustling.englishDescription: Having a chaotic state of mind as one must hurry or there is so much noise.
Being in a chaotic state of mind as one must hurry or there is so much noise.
Having an excessively disordered, confusing quality.

calling.definitionKo: 기독교에서, 사람이 따르도록 되어 있는 하나님의 명령.
calling.englishDescription: In Christianity, an order from God that humans are expected to follow.

calling.definitionKo: 어떤 일에 대해 책임을 맡으라고 하는 사회적 요청.

An occupation for which a person is suited.

cancel.definitionKo: 자신이 내놓은 말이나 제안 등을 취소하다.

cancel.englishDescription: One party to a contract cancels the relationship established by the contract.

cancel.definitionKo: 신문이나 우유 등의 배달을 하지 못하게 하다.
cancel.englishDescription: To stop the delivery of newspaper, milk, etc.

cancel.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하기 이전의 상태로 돌리다.
cancel.englishDescription: To return to the former state of not having done something.

cancel.definitionKo: 이미 발표한 것을 거두어들이거나 약속한 것 또는 예정된 일을 없애다.
cancel.englishDescription: To take back what has been announced, or revoke what has been promised or planned.

cancel.definitionKo: 약속이나 계약 등이 깨지다. 또는 약속이나 계약 등을 깨뜨리다.
cancel.englishDescription: For a promise or contract to be broken; or to break a promise or contract.

carefulness.definitionKo: 좋지 않은 일을 겪지 않도록 말이나 행동 등에 주의를 함.
carefulness.englishDescription: The act of being careful in speech, behavior, etc., not to get in trouble.

carefulness.definitionKo: 잘못이나 실수를 하지 않도록 말이나 행동 등에 주의하는 성질이나 태도.
carefulness.englishDescription: The quality or attitude of being careful in speech, behavior, etc., not to make mistakes or errors.

casino.definitionKo: 춤이나 음악 등의 오락 시설과 함께 룰렛이나 카드놀이 등의 돈내기 게임 시설을 갖춘 도박장.
casino.englishDescription: A gambling house that provides gambling machines and equipment such as roulette wheels, card game tables, etc., and such entertainment as dance, music, etc.

celery.definitionKo: 달걀 모양 잎이 갈라져 나고, 줄기가 굵고 길며 독특한 냄새와 맛이 나는 서양 채소.
celery.englishDescription: A western vegetable that has a thick, long stem with egg-shaped leaves and a unique smell and taste.

chaplain.definitionKo: 기독교 학교에서 예배와 종교 교육을 맡은 목사.
chaplain.englishDescription: A priest who is in charge of worship and religious education in a Christian school.

chatteringly.definitionKo: (속된 말로) 조심하지 않고 아무렇게나 말을 하는 모양.
chatteringly.englishDescription: (slang) In the manner of speaking flippantly.

chatteringly.definitionKo: 실없이 웃으면서 조금 시끄럽게 자꾸 이야기하는 모양.
chatteringly.englishDescription: In a manner of constantly talking a little loudly while laughing frivolously.

cherishing.definitionKo: 동식물이나 물건을 좋아해서 가까이에 두고 귀여워하거나 즐김.
cherishing.englishDescription: A state of being fond of plants, animals, or objects, and therefore keeping them close and cherishing them.

cinema.definitionKo: 연극이나 음악, 무용 등을 공연하거나 영화를 상영하기 위한 시설을 갖춘 장소.
cinema.englishDescription: A place equipped with a stage or screen, for performing plays, music, dance, etc., or showing movies.

clique.definitionKo: 정치적 목적이나 주장이 같은 사람들이 모여서 이룬 단체.
clique.englishDescription: A group formed by people with the same political goal or opinion.

clique.englishDescription: An organization of people with the same interests in politics.

clique.englishDescription: A group of people, divided over profit or loss.

coldly.englishDescription: In the state of being icy due to a low temperature.

Without kindness and with a cold attitude.
With an indifferent and cold attitude or mind.

commandments.definitionKo: 종교를 가지고 있는 사람들이 그에 맞게 지켜야 하는 규율.
commandments.englishDescription: Rules that believers of a religion are expected to follow.

commandments.definitionKo: 종교적, 사회적, 도덕적 생활과 행동에 관해 신의 이름으로 정한 규범.
commandments.englishDescription: The rules decided in the name of God, on religious, social, and moral life and behavior.

competitiveness.definitionKo: 상대와 경쟁해서 이길 수 있는 힘이나 능력.

confidently.englishDescription: In the manner of speaking powerfully and straightforwardly.
In the manner of being absolutely true or being certain of something.

contemptuousness.definitionKo: 매우 싫어하거나 무시하는 듯한 태도로 낮추어 보는 것.

contraction.englishDescription: The process of becoming smaller because it has shrunk or shriveled.
The state in which something contracts or gets smaller in volume as it dries or wilts.

cordial.definitionKo: 다른 사람의 마음에 들게 행동이나 성격이 친절하고 다정하다.
cordial.englishDescription: One's behavior or personality being nice and kind, and pleasing others.

cordial.englishDescription: One's attitude of treating someone being sincere and wholehearted.

counterview.definitionKo: 어떤 사상이나 주장에 반대되는 이론이나 말.
counterview.englishDescription: A theory or statement contrary to a certain idea or argument.

crash.definitionKo: 어떤 물체가 다른 물체에 세차게 부딪치다.

crash.englishDescription: For a ringing sound to be made when sheets of glass or pieces of ice clash with each other or split.
(emphasizing form) For something to hit hard against another.

curtain.definitionKo: 어떤 장소를 가리거나 공간을 나눌 때 사용하는 넓은 천.
curtain.englishDescription: A broad sheet of cloth that is used to cover or partition a place.

curtain.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 어떤 사실이나 현상을 보이지 않도록 가리는 사물.
curtain.englishDescription: (figurative) Something that covers a fact or phenomenon to render it invisible.
A cloth draping down in a theatre, etc.

curtain.definitionKo: 넓은 천을 여러 폭으로 이어서 주위를 빙 둘러치는 막.
curtain.englishDescription: A series of drapes encircling or lining a certain thing.

day-care.definitionKo: 보호자 대신 어린아이를 맡아 돌보는 일.
day-care.englishDescription: The act of taking care of children on behalf of their parents.

deaconess.definitionKo: 기독교에서, 목사나 전도사 등을 도와 다른 교인들을 돌보며 위로하는 직책. 또는 그런 사람.
deaconess.englishDescription: In Christianity, the position of a person who helps a pastor or missionary to care for and console other believers, or a person of such a position.

dealer.englishDescription: A person who is in trade.

dealer.definitionKo: 여기저기서 조금씩 물건을 사 모아 파는 장사. 또는 그런 장사를 하는 사람.
dealer.englishDescription: A business of purchasing goods little by little from here and there and selling them, or a person who is in such a business.

dealer.definitionKo: 상품을 파는 일을 직업으로 하는 사람.
dealer.englishDescription: A person whose job it is to sell a product.

deathplace.englishDescription: A place where a person just died.

den.definitionKo: 나쁜 짓을 하는 무리가 모여 있는 본거지.
den.englishDescription: The base of a group that does bad things.

deojeogori.englishDescription: An outer jeogori worn over a jeogori, a basic upper garment of traditional Korean clothes.

derailment.definitionKo: 기차나 전차 등의 바퀴가 선로를 벗어남.

desirous.englishDescription: For desire to be felt in one's attitude or behavior towards the opposite sex.

different.definitionKo: 두 개의 대상이 서로 같지 아니하다.

warm-up.englishDescription: A light exercise done before a full-fledged workout or game in order to warm up one's body.

warn.englishDescription: To caution someone in advance to be careful of or refrain from dangerous things.

westerlies.englishDescription: Wind that blows from the west to the east all year round, in the middle-latitude regions.

where.englishDescription: The word that means a place which one does not know.
